@ops._comment: JROM = 4-byte magic + 1-byte version + CBOR(AtomicDOM). Caller sets rom_path in @input.

JROM_DECODE.@doc: Decode a JROM binary → return AtomicDOM program object. No execution. Caller provides rom_path.

JROM_EXEC.@doc: Decode a JROM binary and execute the AtomicDOM program. Returns child global_state. Caller provides rom_path.
